about: Jon Paul Hoelscher is an attorney providing legal services covering Construction Litigation: Business, Energy & Natural Resources and Business Litigation.

Jon Hoelscher, who practices law in Houston, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at South Texas College of Law Houston. He graduated in 2005. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 2005.
